image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a vintage-style comic book or pulp magazine cover. The cover features a dark background with a teal/green border. The title at the top reads 'MUTLOON' (or similar gibberish) in a distressed, blocky font. The central illustration depicts two stylized, ghostly figures: one appears to be a female figure with flowing hair/dress on the left, and the other a male figure riding a horse or creature on the right, both rendered in a rough, sketch-like beige/white style. Below the illustration is a block of text that is largely illegible/gibberish, resembling credits or a tagline. The object rests on a wooden surface.

The figures have a 'smudged' or 'melting' quality, lacking the crisp line work typical of comic book ink. The edges bleed into the background slightly.
The anatomy of the horse and rider is indistinct and merges together. It is unclear where the rider ends and the mount begins; legs are missing or fused.
